BETTY LOU ORMONDE

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and give that
card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting. Please
observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS
LISTED UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public wishes to speak
on a Consent Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for
separate discussion and to allow the member of the public to speak on the Consent
Calendar item at that time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, MARCH 9, 2020
  7:00 P.M.
The Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 7:00 p.m., on Monday,
March 9, 2020 in the Artesia City Council Chambers by Mayor Ali Taj. The Invocation was
presented by Pastor Bob De Leon, Calvary Chapel Artesia. The Pledge of Allegiance was led by
Public Safety Commission Chairperson, Betty Lou Ormonde.

PRESENT:  Ali Taj, Mayor

  Edith Guerra, Assistant Parks and Recreation Manager

  City Manager Rawlings stated that last year, the Council approved a $250 rebate for

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino requested a Staff Report

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments. Mayor Pro Tem asked if it was possible to
  gain assurance from the applicant that the family would occupy the property.

  City Manager Rawlings advised that such considerations should not be made from the
  dais, and suggested that concerns could be addressed by the Council directing Staff to
  do investigate and return in the future.

  Interim City Attorney Leishman seconded the remarks by City Manager Rawlings, and
  reviewed the options in the Staff Report.

  Councilmember Lima provided comments

  City Council Action: Item No. 16 was approved without objection 4-0-0-1

DISCUSSION

  18. MIDYEAR BUDGET UPDATE

  City Manager Rawlings reported the City is on budget, expenses are being managed,
  and the City has obtained almost $9 million in additional revenues in the form of grants.
  City Manager stated that Staff continues to manage the expenses of the City very
  carefully to ensure that we stay within budget, and that the estimate of revenues has
  been accurate and the City has been able to bring in more revenues in the form of
  grants. City Manager concluded this remarks stating that the budget is balanced and
  continues to be implemented as directed by the Council.

  Mayor Taj provided comments

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM NO. 18

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  City Council Action: Item No. 18 was approved without objection 4-0-0-1

COUNCILMEMBER/STAFF INFORMATIONAL REPORTING

  19. COUNCILMEMBER’S REPORTING ON EXTERNAL BOARDS AND COMMITTEE
  MEETINGS ATTENDED

  Councilmember Lima reported on the Council of Government’s (COG) meeting where
  housing was discussed

  Councilmember Ramoso reported that she attended the Greater Los Angeles County
  Vector Control District (GLACVCD) meeting on February 13, 2020 where she became
  the Risk Management Committee Vice Chair.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino reported that he attended the Southeastern Los Angeles County
  Workforce Development Board (SELACO). Mayor Pro Tem Trevino reported that
  SELACO will be adding Paramount to the group, and that meetings will be rotated
  beginning in July and Artesia will be the first City to host the meeting. Mayor Pro Tem
  also reported on the California League of Cities where mobilizing youth and youth
  activity was discussed.

  6
   Mayor Taj reported on the EcoRapid Transit meeting where the train station was
  discussed, including environmental studies.

  20. COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS ON MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino reported that he attended the Soroptomist International event

  Councilmember Ramoso reported that she attended the Soroptomist International event

  Mayor Taj reported that he attended the Soroptomist International event

  21. CITY MANAGER INFORMATION BRIEF

  City Manager informed the Council there was no brief tonight

  Mayor Taj provided comments, thanked City Manager Rawlings for his leadership and
  encouraged City Manager Rawlings to keep up the great work.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Lima provided comments

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments

  Mayor Taj provided comments

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Taj adjourned the meeting in memory of former Public Safety Commissioner CJ
  Oliver. The City Council observed a moment of silence.

  The meeting adjourned at at 9:15 pm.
